title: Microsoft Purview Failures by Data Source
app: Microsoft Purview scan and data-access events via the Purview REST API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=purview:scan status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by data_source
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Microsoft Purview failures grouped by data source so operators immediately see which specific data sources are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Microsoft Purview is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Microsoft Purview failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical data sources.
visualization: Table of data source by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Microsoft Purview are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
